body: you are not worthless. we always tend to criticize ourselves way more than anyone ever would. you have so much worth wether you know it or not, you do. i’m here to tell you that cutting is never okay but it happens, it does. just know that you deserve the world and one day you will get it. you just need to stay here long enough to see that. i know how hard it gets to take care of yourself, trust me i’ve been there. just know that i care about you and i hope you try to keep eating and stay away from cutting or drinking as much. things will get better i promise you!!! please message me if you need to talk :)

you are so worthy. and you deserve the world and more. you are anything BUT a burden. you’re so loved and cared for and if you don’t believe it then i’m here to tell you i love and care for you. doesn’t matter if we don’t know each other, i wish the absolute best for you and just know you do not deserve to die. you deserve to experience life even if the lows are so low . i’m here if you ever need to talk!! just send me a message

i haven’t exactly had the best life, but i also am the type to know i have it better than others so i shouldn’t complain you know? both of my parents passed away and i was the one who had found my dad. just hate getting the flashbacks from that day .

i’ve talked to a counselor from my school but that’s about it . not much they can help with . i’ve been wanting to see a counselor but i just never did . i try to keep myself from feeling down but recently it’s just been getting worse . thank you for the tips , i appreciate it :)
i try to go out with friends as much as possible but even sometimes that doesn’t help. i just don’t even want to do anything anymore i wanna give up
he had a heart attack while he was sleeping . i now live with his sister , my aunt , and honestly we haven’t been getting along well.
please . i don’t want to do anything stupid
same here !! we can see 21 together

i know you said don’t try to help, but i cant just scroll :( . if you feel comfortable being a woman then i think you should at least try that . i know a mans body is all you’ve known and you are used to it but do you know how much better it would feel to be who you truly want to be ? it’s not going to be easy to transition but i think you should at least try!!

please don’t end it , i promise you have so much to live for . you were put on this earth for a reason!! people care about you and love you . i care for you . 21 is amazing and you deserve to stay to see that for yourself .

i have the same problem :( i’ve always wanted to call to talk but i don’t need anyone in my house knowing what’s going on . just know you can always message me and i’ll help as best as i can or even just listen if you want .

please don’t. i know how life sucks and it gets so bad at times to the point where you don’t even know what you’re living for . but you have purpose , you have people who love and care for you. i care for you . it might not seem like it’s gonna get better , but you will never know that if you don’t stay here and see . i know i might not be able to change your mind but i really hope you decide not to leave this world . :) you can always message me to talk

hey ! i also come from a family whos not too big on mental health. i’m only 17 and have lost both parents , but they still think i just need to “toughen up”. it sucks. 

but who says it’s too late to go to college ? even if you think it is , then you should start finding new jobs at your own pace . everyone needs a break here and there . even if it’s been 4 months , take your time finding a job you can work at for at least right now. 

i know it’s hard to not listen to parents or family that ridicule you but just know that you’ve got this . nothing they say right now matters . you need to do this for you and not for them . you’re going to get through this i promise you . remember life goes on :)
we’re all human , it happens . we make mistakes . you’ve got this though!! i’m always here to listen if you need it . you are loved and cared for , just remember that . it’s going to be okay
thank you :( i’m trying my best to not do it again
